description: MCHPRS (Minecraft High-Performance Redstone Server): Minecraft 1.20.4 creative server for computational redstone. Each plot runs on its own thread; Redpiler compiles redstone for speed.
notes: Start it from 'Scoop Apps' > 'MCHPRS (Minecraft server)', or with the command 'mchprs' in a console.
Both run it in its data folder, so settings, worlds and logs land in
%USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\MCHPRS\server: they survive updates, and only 'scoop uninstall -p' deletes them.
Stop the server with Ctrl+C (or /stop in game) before 'scoop update' or 'scoop uninstall'.
Windows Firewall asks on the first start, and again after each update (the exe moves to a new folder).
Every server listens on port 25565 by default: run one at a time, or change the port in its config.
Creative plots for redstone only: no survival, mobs or world generation. Clients must be Minecraft 1.20.4.

script: # The server works in the current folder, so the command and the shortcut start it in the persisted 'server' folder.
':: MCHPRS: starts the server; /PAUSE (used by the Scoop Apps shortcut) keeps the window open when it stops.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
':: Only the shortcut''s own window gets a title; a console that runs the command keeps its title.',
'ECHO MCHPRS: Minecraft 1.20.4 creative server built for redstone, written in Rust.',
'ECHO Settings, worlds and logs: persist\MCHPRS\server in your Scoop folder.',
'ECHO Players connect to this computer on port 25565 unless the server config says otherwise.',
'ECHO Press Ctrl+C to stop the server; it saves the plots first.',
':: The server reads and writes its files in the current folder: the persisted "server" folder.',
